== Early life ==
Qaisuddin was born on 15 July 1937 in Alinagar Union of [[Gomostapur Upazila|Gomstapur Upazila]] of [[Chapai Nawabganj District]].

Qaisuddin passed with honors from [[Rajshahi University]] in 1957, and completed his master's degree from [[University of Dhaka]]. He received a Commonwealth Scholarship for PhD research from [[University of Glasgow|Glasgow University, UK]] in 1961. He was awarded the Commonwealth Academic Staff Fellowship for post-doctoral research at the [[Imperial College London|Imperial College of Science and Technology.]]{{citation needed|date=April 2023}}

== Career ==
He was the founding chairman of the biochemistry department at [[University of Rajshahi|Rajshahi University]] in 1976.<ref>{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=Preview of Bio Chemistry Department|url=http://www.ru.ac.bd/biochemistry/|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2020-12-12|website=[[University of Rajshahi]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=About Biochemistry and Molecular Biology|url=http://dept.ru.ac.bd/biochem/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150520220923/http://dept.ru.ac.bd/biochem/|archive-date=2015-05-20|access-date=2020-12-12|website=[[Rajshahi University]]|language=en-US|url-status=dead}}</ref> He was dean of the Faculty of Science of [[University of Rajshahi|Rajshahi University]], president of Rajshahi University Teachers Association (RUTA), and a syndicate member of Islamic University, Bangladesh.<ref name="alokito-chapainawabganj"/>

=== Vice-chancellorship ===
Qaisuddin became the vice chancellor of Islamic University on 3 September 1997.<ref>{{Cite web|script-title=bn:ইসলামী বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় - বাংলাপিডিয়া|url=http://bn.banglapedia.org/index.php?title=%E0%A6%87%E0%A6%B8%E0%A6%B2%E0%A6%BE%E0%A6%AE%E0%A7%80_%E0%A6%AC%E0%A6%BF%E0%A6%B6%E0%A7%8D%E0%A6%AC%E0%A6%AC%E0%A6%BF%E0%A6%A6%E0%A7%8D%E0%A6%AF%E0%A6%BE%E0%A6%B2%E0%A6%AF%E0%A6%BC|access-date=2020-12-12|website=bn.banglapedia.org|language=bn}}</ref>{{failed verification|date=June 2025}} After serving for three years, he joined [[Bangladesh Open University]] as a vice chancellor.
